28OCT 2026
Latest listed release

Expanded content support and launcher improvements

Community notes describe GTA Online DLC pack support for story mode, a launcher-first Mac flow, expanded trainer support, and new iOS and macOS builds.

Highlights

  • Community release notes describe four GTA Online DLC collections organized by release period.
  • Mac users receive a launcher-first flow with graphics, mod, save-management, and trainer improvements.
  • The project notes a 32 add-on pack limit and recommends limiting enabled content on lower-memory devices.

Support

If you report a problem, include your platform, exact build date, device model, and non-sensitive logs. Never include passwords, authentication codes, certificates, private keys, or account tokens.

26OCT 2026
Previous release

GPU efficiency and mission fixes

Memory compression returned, MetalFX output resolution was corrected, and a 40 FPS limiter was added.

Performance

  • Release notes reported lower GPU work per frame after memory compression was restored.
  • MetalFX was adjusted to target the screen's actual output resolution.
  • A 40 FPS frame-limit option was added between 30 and 45 FPS.

Fixes

  • The Merryweather Heist black-screen or frozen-camera issue on some 4 GB devices was addressed.
  • Touch interaction in By the Book was updated.
  • Leftover debug logging was removed.

25OCT 2026
Previous release

Mac preview and expanded input support

Apple silicon Mac testing, keyboard and mouse controls, Self Radio, controller navigation, and trainer expansion.

Highlights

  • First preview for Apple silicon Macs on macOS 14 or later.
  • Keyboard and mouse input for supported iPhone and iPad configurations.
  • Self Radio import, background audio behavior, settings sharing, controller navigation, and expanded trainer content.
  • Experimental A12-family support was included for community testing.
